annotations.title: Come and See: for a seeker from another faith, or none

description: Read the house's respectful comparison page for a person of another religion or worldview who is curious about Jesus (14 held, including Islam, Judaism, Buddhism, Hinduism, Sikhism, the Baha'i Faith, Stoicism, New Age and the occult), fetched live from living-bread.org/come-and-see: the page text, the questions it links to, verses it names (verbatim KJV) and links to talk with a real person. Use for "I'm Muslim, what do Christians believe about Isa" or "I grew up Hindu, how is Jesus different". Not for comparing two Christian traditions (denomination_compare) or the gospel itself (the_gospel). Self-descriptions like "Muslim" or "astrology" are mapped to the right page; "none" or no page held returns matched null with the list of pages and a pointer to who-is-jesus. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

background.description: The person's religion or worldview in their own words: "Muslim", "grew up Hindu", "Jewish", "Buddhist", "Sikh", "Stoic", "new age", "astrology", "nothing really".

name: christianity_and_other_faiths

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

body.description: Page text (up to about 1,200 characters), the house's words.

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

doors.description: Links: come_and_see, who_is_jesus, a_table, a_shepherd, talk.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

matched.description: Path of the page used, or null when none was held.

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

posture.description: The house's stance: respectful, no argument, an invitation to a conversation.

questions.description: Questions the page opens, each its own page.

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

suggestions.description: When matched is null: every comparison page held.

verses.description: Verses named on the page, verbatim KJV (up to 3).

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.
